en: A sepia-toned architectural photograph of a Mughal-style pavilion built of light-colored stone, with intricate jali (latticed) screens, carved brackets, and a domed chhatri on the roof. The structure stands at the edge of a fort wall or high platform, with railings and balconies overlooking a drop on one side. There are no printed captions on the front aside from a small numeric code in the bottom-right margin.
